ordered_diagnoses: Leukemia Cutis of Acute Myeloid Leukemia

s1.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic eruptive facial lesion in a patient with hematologic malignancy
salient_findings: Atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells
Identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens
key_facts: 3×2–mm smooth, red, dome-shaped papule under the right lower eyelid
Diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells
Hypercellular bone marrow with atypical erythropoiesis
10% to 15% myeloblasts in bone marrow biopsy specimens
Identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens

shortlist: Leukemia Cutis of Acute Myeloid Leukemia

shortlist.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Uniformly positive for CD207/langerin and presence of diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells

shortlist.label: Myeloid Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of chronic high-grade myelodysplastic syndrome and refractory anemia with excess blasts, with identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens

shortlist.label: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical diffuse dermal monocytoid-appearing infiltrate and history of hematologic malignancy

shortlist.label: Myeloid Leukemia Cutis
shortlist.why_kept: History of myelodysplastic syndrome and refractory anemia with excess blasts, with skin involvement

shortlist.label: Leukemia Cutis of Acute Myeloid Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: History of chronic high-grade myelodysplastic syndrome and refractory anemia with excess blasts, with skin involvement and presence of myeloblasts in bone marrow biopsy specimens

raw.rationale: The patient's skin biopsy showed a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells that were uniformly positive for CD207/langerin, which is a specific marker for Langerhans cells, and the presence of the BRAF-V600E variant is also consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Myeloid Sarcoma
rejected.why: The biopsy specimen was negative for myeloperoxidase, which is typically positive in myeloid sarcomas.

rejected.label: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
rejected.why: There is no specific mention of markers or features typical for this rare and aggressive neoplasm.

rejected.label: Myeloid Leukemia Cutis
rejected.why: While the patient has myelodysplastic syndrome, the specific immunohistochemical profile does not align with myeloid leukemia cutis.

rejected.label: Leukemia Cutis of Acute Myeloid Leukemia
rejected.why: The lack of myeloperoxidase positivity and the specific langerin positivity point away from this diagnosis.
